verdict.rationale: Entra ID ships its own automated workflow capability. Lifecycle Workflows are processes that "run automatically against users as they move through their lifecycle," and automatic provisioning to SaaS apps adds further unattended automation. Neither source documents user-defined schedules or recurrence, so the story is only glancingly supported. missing for 10: explicit scheduling/recurrence configuration (cron-like or interval triggers), general-purpose job scheduling beyond identity lifecycle events, independent or hands-on corroboration.
